data.residual_risk: Wrong-state/role and in-flight guards, Worker/sidecar validation, write-failure rollback, and old-authorization rejection were not exercised; branch coverage is unknown.

scenarios.behavior: A stale pending Tester handoff refreshes to a PM-produced Tester event bound to the current report.
Refresh increments revision and preserves Pending Test status and Work Items.
The new receipt retains Worker session and original implementation event.
Old receipt is cancelled and old/new receipts link bidirectionally.
Independent Tester claims refreshed event and submits dual report to PM.
Current handoff rejects refresh without receipt changes.
Claimed stale handoff rejects refresh without FD or receipt changes.
Missing implementation report rejects refresh without FD or receipt changes.
New event keeps Tester target role and original report path.
Wrong FD state or non-Tester role rejects refresh.
Launching or dispatched handoff rejects refresh.
Missing Worker identity or invalid Dual sidecar rejects refresh.
Write failure rolls back FD, old receipt, index and removes claimable orphan.
Old test authorization cannot be reused for refreshed event.

static_exclusions: CLI help, completion, and documentation wording are non-behavioral acceptance items and excluded from this behavior scenario denominator.
